active_frequency_certificate.proof: The leading and constant coefficients are negative, the linear coefficient is positive, and the discriminant is positive, so the two roots are positive.  The polynomial is concave; P(64)<0 and P'(64)>0 place 64 strictly to the left of its smaller root.  Hence both positive active frequencies are sqrt(root)>8.
